name: SecureWebArena
description: First holistic security benchmark for web agents, built on six real web environments.
descriptionZh: 首个面向 Web Agent 的整体安全基准，构建于六个真实 Web 环境之上。
frontier: 6 real web environments, 2,970 adversarial trajectories, 6 attack vector categories
frontierZh: 6 个真实 Web 环境、2,970 条对抗轨迹、6 类攻击向量
credibility: Fills a specific gap: browser agents had capability benchmarks (WebArena) long before anyone measured how easily they can be steered by adversarial page content. Accepted to ACL 2026 Findings.
credibilityZh: 填补了一个明确空白：浏览器 Agent 早就有能力基准（WebArena），但「它们多容易被页面上的对抗内容操纵」长期无人测量。已被 ACL 2026 Findings 接收。
keyFact: SecureWebArena is the first holistic security benchmark for LVLM-based web agents, spanning six real web environments and 2,970 adversarial trajectories, and was accepted to ACL 2026 Findings.
keyFactZh: SecureWebArena 是首个面向 LVLM Web Agent 的整体安全基准，覆盖 6 个真实 Web 环境与 2,970 条对抗轨迹，已被 ACL 2026 Findings 接收。
